finding.text: Ask 2 is not met: `ux/Dictate` is not rebuilt on MicStream + Transcriber. `MicStream`'s buffer is still a copy of `ux/Dictate/capture.js`, and Whisper's silence rule is still copied. The readme says so itself: "`ux/Dictate` is not rebuilt on these yet". `Dictate.js` and `capture.js` do not appear in the diff.

The old URLs `/framework/audio/MicPicker/`, `/LevelMeter/` and `/PushToTalk/` now show "Page Load Error" (see shots/…-audio-MicPicker/sheet.png). Ask 1 said to keep thin aliases, or remove them only after every caller moves. The pages moved to `/v1/`, but nothing redirects from the old paths, and `core/Page/audit/data.js` still names the old paths.

On /framework/audio/ at 400px the three demo cards have ragged widths: card 2 is wide and card 3 is narrow. Card 2's state line is cut off as "Transcriber…." (shots/…-framework-audio/400.png, middle band).

The Dictate page is 5 screens tall at 400px (layout.json tab-panel share 5.076). Below the widget, two paragraphs run about 90 words each ("Why it was silent before", "What actually moved"). That is content question 3, and those paragraphs belong in Docs.
The v1 page's in-page link row ("Overview MicPicker LevelMeter PushT…") is cut off at the right edge at 400px (shots/…-audio-v1/400 in sheet.png).

In the Dictate widget the level meter is a tiny grey sliver squeezed at the end of the core row, beside Send (shots/…-ux-Dictate/400.png). Controls question 23 wants extras like the meter on a line underneath.
